title: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.8739558 via Sil's density-split bootstrap with a 46-step chain and a retuned return
description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet boundary 4369779/5000000 = 0.8739558, with the principal pole excluded. Sil's density-split common-divisor bootstrap (PR 83) with a longer source chain: 30 explicit native cube-free steps from the fourth-power face G(99999/100000, 93/25, 3/50), Sil's subface step, and 46 variable-density transitions, reaching G(9888151/10000000, 4683001/2000000, 1/10). Sil's all-shift physical return is reused with three constants changed (m_minus = 377/1000, the physical face equal to the source face with cap 31/500, h = 8051/10000) and its generated rows and admission guards regenerated on Sil's own boxes. All analytic steps are Sil's generic theorems, unchanged; only the step instances, their exact certificates and the return constants are new. Builds on OpenAI's original framework, Hailey Collet's generic source, counting and return machinery (PR 69), Sil's fourth-power source (PR 74) and density-split bootstrap (PR 83), and ArviFoxy's broadened source interface and all-shift physical return (PR 76); inherited authorship and license notices are retained. The research, certificate generation and Lean changes were AI-assisted (Claude).
